attempts.sql:
SELECT folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN file_id = 'auto_ontology/server' THEN NULL
      ELSE SUBSTR(file_id, 1, INSTR(SUBSTR(file_id, 13), '/') + 12)
    END AS folder_path,
    line_count
  FROM code.files
  WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%'
    AND (module LIKE '%.py' OR file_id LIKE '%.py')
)
GROUP BY folder_path
HAVING total_lines > 1000
ORDER BY total_lines DESC
